div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Template & Methodology Governance
- Manage Unsupported markdown: del13 Types)
- Schemas, Presentation Models, Layouts
- Lifecycle: Draft->Reviewed->Approved->Published
- Methodology Rules: Mandatory Fields, Validations
- Context Taxonomy: businessProcess, activity, subActivity
- Mappings to Templates
(Containers, DynamoDB for Storage)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Workpaper Authoring & Lifecycle
- Create from Templates (workpaperId, templateType)
- Store Structured Fields, Narratives
- Context: auditEngagementId, businessProcess etc.
- State Machine: Draft->In Review->Rework->Approved->Finalized
- Immutable Versions on Save
- Generate Exports (PDF/Word) with Hashes
(Containers, DynamoDB for Content)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Collaboration & Review
- Threaded Comments Anchored to Fields/Sections
- Review Assignments & Workflows
- Notifications (Email/In-App) for Mentions, Changes
- Presence Indicators for Parallel Editing
(Containers, DynamoDB for Metadata)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Intelligent Assistance & Automation
- AI Orchestration Service
- Generative: Drafting, Summarizing, Gap Checks
- Agentic: Evidence Assembly, Pre-Populate, Test Plans
- Human-in-the-Loop: Suggestions Only
- Log Prompts/Outputs to Audit Trail
- Data Masking/Minimization
- Integrate with GS-AI (Lambda Triggers)
(Containers, Lambda for AI Invocations)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Governance, Audit Trail & Lineage
- Append-Only Event Store (All Actions: Edits, AI, Exports)
- Tamper-Evident Logs
- Data Lineage: Sources to Workpapers to Exports
- Cryptographic Hashes for Integrity Verification
- Retention & Access Governance
- Historical Reconstruction APIs
(Containers, Kinesis for Events, S3 Archive)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Usage Analytics & Operational Insights
- Collect Telemetry/Events
- Compute KPIs: Time per Stage, Revisions, AI Impact
- Segments by Context Dimensions
- Dashboards for Bottlenecks, Adoption
- Entitlement-Aware (No Micro-Surveillance)
(Containers, Athena Queries, QuickSight Viz)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Platform & Cross-Cutting Services
- IAM: Cognito SSO, RBAC/ABAC
- Security: KMS Encryption, Secrets Mgr
- Infra: EKS Scaling, Backup/Restore
- Observability: CloudWatch Logs/Metrics/Alarms
- Integration: API GW, EventBridge, SQS
- Data Storage Patterns: Regional Isolation
(Shared Across Domains)
